Kind: installed (preview)

checkout_recovery_reminders — Find when checkout recovery and abandoned cart reminders are sent.
Owner: commerce
Kind: installed (read-only)
Runtime editing needs episode lineage and delivery replay evidence.
Default: {"revision":"default","abandonedCart":[{"stage":"first","afterHours":1},{"stage":"gentle","afterHours":24},{"stage":"last","afterHours":72}],"checkoutRecovery":[{"stage":"first","afterHours":1},{"stage":"last","afterHours":20}]}
Basis: reference-code (matches the reference deployment’s code)
The last checkout wave fits inside the 24-hour checkout window and the cart waves retain the established delivery timing.
Unpinned checkout recovery episodes use host call parameters, with SQL defaults for omitted offsets. Unpinned abandoned cart episodes use 1, 24 and 72 hours. An existing pin supplies that episode's timing.
Schema: null
Effect: A changed schedule supplies timing for new episodes. Follow-up waves of pinned episodes retain the recorded schedule. Older unpinned episodes use live timing.
Frozen on: Enqueued messages and send receipts retain their recorded identity.
Change: installCheckoutRecoveryReminderSchedule

catalog.bundleAvailabilityPolicy: file not-reported, schema not-validated
  Effect: BundleAvailabilityServiceDeps (lowStockThreshold default 3, includeAddonsInStock default false) and DeriveBundleAvailabilityInput in @openlup/platform/catalog. Controls derived bundle status and whether add-on components constrain sellableNow. Non-integer or negative lowStockThreshold values reject at runtime. Change: docs/guide/how-to/build/bundles.md
checkout.resumeWindowMinutes: file not-reported, schema not-validated
  Effect: CheckoutHandlerDependencies.resumeWindowMinutes (and CheckoutResumeGuardDeps) passes withinMinutes (default 60) to CommerceResumableOrderReadPort.findResumableOrderForClient during checkout resume and saved acquisition continuation checks. Values outside 1..2147483647 throw at runtime. Change: docs/guide/concepts/checkout.md#attempts-and-payment-hand-off
checkout_recovery_reminders: file not-reported, schema not-validated
  Effect: A changed schedule supplies timing for new episodes. Follow-up waves of pinned episodes retain the recorded schedule. Older unpinned episodes use live timing. Change: installCheckoutRecoveryReminderSchedule
  Store: not checked. The starter checks its installed file policies for drift at boot, and preview shows the effect where supported.
communications.nativeDeliveryControls: file not-reported, schema not-validated
  Effect: Controls native communications delivery eligibility in public.communication_delivery_controls (control_key, enabled, revision), evaluated when preparing new delivery commands and lifecycle notification gates. Because public.communication_delivery_controls has REVOKE ALL from default roles (PUBLIC, anon, authenticated), connected reads require an explicit SELECT grant on public.communication_delivery_controls (otherwise returning commerce_setting_read_unavailable). Change: communications_set_delivery_control
  Store: not checked. The starter checks its installed file policies for drift at boot, and preview shows the effect where supported.
communications.terminalPayloadRetentionDays: file not-reported, schema not-validated
  Effect: Passed as processedDays and discardedDays (integers 1..3650) to createOutbox(..., { prune: { enabled: true, processedDays, discardedDays, ... } }) or createPostgresOutboxCompactor().compact({ processedDays, discardedDays, limit }) from @openlup/outbox. Clears payload and error on processed rows older than processedDays and discarded rows with a valid metadata.discardedAt older than discardedDays while retaining the event row, unique enqueue key, and retentionCompacted* metadata. Change: docs/guide/how-to/build/outbox.md#retain-terminal-work-safely
inventory.offerLowStockThreshold: file not-reported, schema not-validated
  Effect: Passed as lowStockThreshold (default DEFAULT_LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 20) to statusForSellableNow, deriveOfferAvailability, createOfferAvailabilityPort (@openlup/platform/commerce and /commerce/server), and createNewPurchaseStockAvailabilityPort (@openlup/platform/inventory). Positive stock <= threshold reports low_stock; 0 disables low_stock warnings. Non-integer or negative values reject at runtime. Change: docs/guide/concepts/catalogue-and-prices.md#sellability-and-availability

market.settlementProfile: file not-reported, schema not-validated
  Effect: Environment variables COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY (^[A-Z]{3}$) and COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_REGION (^[A-Z]{2}$) drive readSettlementProfile (@openlup/platform/market-packs), while mandatory mirror rows key='settlement_currency' and key='settlement_region' in public.commerce_settings govern SQL price lists, base-price writes, and readiness gates. WARNING: Do NOT change settlement currency in a live store with existing orders, price lists, or active subscriptions; changing currency breaks historical price-list matching and financial integrity.
